clauses.clause: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a creature card with mana value 6 or greater,
clauses.evidence: the trigger fires on cast and the may is asked ('ask may: [fire, skip]'), but no library card in the trace qualifies, so no search result is ever shown. Tree = the compiler's B2b-fierce-empath-etb parse (its search pick is the canonical ONE_OF). Known engine limit, not a card fault: a library search that finds something cannot fail to find (BACKLOG B-107, CR 701.19b), for every tutor. Packs: D09_1 (only the two creatures of mana value 6 or more are offered, one goes to hand), D09_2 (6 counts, 5 does not), D09_3 and D09_5 (nothing in my library qualifies; the opponent's library is not searched), D09_4 (declining the may does nothing).

judged from the tree and the trace: A(Verb.REVEAL, controller YOU, count 1) follows the SEARCH inside the OptionalEffect, as in the compiler's parse. The runner has no REVEAL lane and a REVEAL after a SEARCH names the library's top card, so no pack can read it.
nothing is found in the trace. SEARCH destination Zone(HAND, YOU). Packs D09_1 and D09_2 (the found card is in my hand, the other candidates and the opponent's card stay in the library).

judged from the tree: A(Verb.SHUFFLE, zone Zone(LIBRARY, YOU)) is the last step of the may's Seq, so declining the may does not shuffle (pack D09_4 pins the library order after a decline); no lane tells a shuffle from its absence after a search.
